summary: Iter62 — End-to-end live verification of (a) Excel Smart Import for /tmp/xlsx_test/PRJ-0031_v2.xlsx and (b) Total CTC includes AMS cost. BOTH features are BROKEN due to TWO DISTINCT CRITICAL BUGS reproduced live in the browser. (1) Smart Import drops the AMS_Shared sheet entirely — only 3 of 4 waves load. (2) The 'CTC + AMS cost' fix was applied to the wrong source file — the live code path imports from a different util and still excludes AMS cost from Total CTC.

integration_issues.issue: P0: AMS_Shared wave with zero implementation resource allocations is silently dropped by the parser. Live Smart Import Preview dialog shows '3 Waves Detected, 6 Total Resources' and lists ONLY: Cost sheet(3 res), AMS - FTE(1 res), AMS - FTE + SSS(2 res). The 'AMS ' sheet (engagement_type=AMS_Shared, 0 resources, 1 bucket = 150 hrs × $35 = $5,250/mo) is MISSING from the preview AND from the final imported waves. After clicking 'Replace Current', only 3 wave tabs are rendered (data-testid=wave-tab-* count=3) — confirmed via Playwright DOM inspection. Toast confirmed 'Imported 3 wave(s) with 6 resource(s).' ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/utils/excelImport.js L205 — `if (allocations.length > 0) { ... parsedWaves.push(...) }` — the entire wave-parsing block (logistics parse + AMS SHARED SUPPORT parse + parsedWaves.push at L319) is gated by allocations.length > 0. Empty-allocation AMS_Shared sheets are silently skipped. The standalone test parser at /tmp/parse_full.cjs does NOT have this gate (verified line 134 pushes unconditionally), which is why main agent's offline test wrongly passed.

integration_issues.flow: Overall Summary — Total CTC card includes AMS cost
integration_issues.issue: P0: 'CTC includes AMS cost' fix is in the WRONG FILE. The PR statement says the fix is at /app/frontend/src/utils/calculations.js L115-129 (calculateWaveSummary now adds amsTotalCost to costToCompany). However, /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectEstimator.js L16 imports `calculateOverallSummary as calcOverallSummaryUtil` from '@/utils/estimatorCalcs.js' (NOT from '@/utils/calculations.js'). The live estimatorCalcs.js:133 has `costToCompany = totalBaseSalaryCost + totalOverheadCost;` with NO amsTotalCost added. Consequently the Total CTC card ([data-testid=total-ctc]) will NEVER include AMS bucket cost, and the '+ AMS cost ($X)' subtitle in OverallSummary.js L138 will NEVER render (it conditions on `overall.totalAmsCost > 0`, but estimatorCalcs.js does not expose `totalAmsCost` — it exposes `totalAmsSharedAnnual` which uses hourly_rate (selling), not cost_rate, and is rolled into grandTotalFinalPrice on a separate row). calculations.js exists but appears UNUSED by the estimator page.

issues: Carry-over hydration warnings from visual-editor instrumentation (<span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr>/<tbody>/<th>/<option>/<select>). Pre-existing from iter57-61, not introduced this round.

action_items: FIX P0 BUG #1 (Import drops AMS_Shared sheet): In /app/frontend/src/utils/excelImport.js — restructure the `if (allocations.length > 0)` gate at L205 so AMS_Shared sheets with zero resource rows still get parsed and pushed. Either move the parsedWaves.push outside the gate, OR change the condition to `if (allocations.length > 0 || hasAmsSharedSupportMarker)`. The AMS SHARED SUPPORT section parse (L277-316) and parsedWaves.push (L319-331) currently sit INSIDE the gate. Recommended: extract logistics+AMS parsing and the push to run if either allocations.length > 0 OR an AMS SHARED SUPPORT section exists on the sheet (pre-scan rows 1..wsRowCount for cellA matching /AMS SHARED SUPPORT/i to decide). Also ensure phase_names/duration default sensibly when no allocations exist (the AMS sheet's phaseRanges should still be 0 or 1 dummy phase).

FIX P0 BUG #2 (Total CTC missing AMS): In /app/frontend/src/utils/estimatorCalcs.js calculateWaveSummary (L133), add AMS bucket cost to costToCompany using the SAME formula as calculations.js L116-126: `const isAms = (wave.engagement_type === 'AMS_Shared' || wave.engagement_type === 'AMS_Mix'); const amsTotalCost = isAms ? (wave.ams_shared_buckets || []).reduce((s,b) => s + (parseFloat(b.hours_per_month)||0) * (parseFloat(b.cost_rate)||0), 0) * (parseInt(wave.ams_contract_months)||12) : 0; const costToCompany = totalBaseSalaryCost + totalOverheadCost + amsTotalCost;` Then expose `amsTotalCost` in the return object, and aggregate it as `totalAmsCost` in calculateOverallSummary (L181-244) so OverallSummary.js L138 subtitle renders correctly. Also include AMS cost in onsite/offshore CTC if applicable (currently L163-164 use salary+overhead only). Recommended: either delete /app/frontend/src/utils/calculations.js (unused dead code) or sync the two files — the duplication itself is a hazard.

REGRESSION CHECK PASSED: No phantom rows on Cost sheet (3 resources) or AMS-FTE (1 resource) or AMS-FTE+SSS (2 resources) — counts in Smart Import Preview match expected. iter60 phantom-row fix is still intact.
critical_code_review_comments: DUPLICATE-CODE HAZARD: /app/frontend/src/utils/calculations.js and /app/frontend/src/utils/estimatorCalcs.js both define `calculateResourceBaseCost`, `calculateResourceSellingPrice`, `calculateWaveLogistics`, `calculateWaveSummary`, `calculateOverallSummary` with overlapping but DIVERGENT formulas (calculations.js uses simple selling price formula; estimatorCalcs.js adds override_hourly_rate*176 logic, onsiteCTC/offshoreCTC split, AMS billing aggregates, effectiveProfitMargin). ProjectEstimator.js imports ONLY from estimatorCalcs.js. The PR fix went into calculations.js (unused). Strong recommendation: delete calculations.js or mark deprecated; all new financial logic must go into estimatorCalcs.js.

excelImport.js L205 gating is too aggressive — any sheet representing an AMS Shared Support engagement with no implementation resources is dropped silently with NO user warning. Even after fixing the gate, surface a console.warn or include the dropped sheet in `result.warnings` so future regressions are visible.

estimatorCalcs.js L142-148 `amsSharedMonthly` uses `hourly_rate` (which is the AMS SELLING price), but the CTC/AMS-cost requirement in the PR specifies `cost_rate` (the AMS COST price). These are two different fields on the bucket. Make sure the AMS fix in CTC uses `cost_rate`, while the existing `amsSharedMonthly`/`amsSharedAnnual` aggregates (which feed Grand Total Final Price) continue to use `hourly_rate`. Otherwise revenue and CTC will be conflated.
Hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr>/<tbody>/<th>/<option>/<select> from visual-editor instrumentation continue to pollute the console — same as iter57-61.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two distinct fixes are required before retest. (1) Patch /app/frontend/src/utils/excelImport.js: pre-scan each non-summary sheet for an 'AMS SHARED SUPPORT' header row; if found OR allocations.length > 0, parse & push the wave. Easiest patch: at L205 change to `if (allocations.length > 0 || hasAmsSharedSupportSection(ws))` where the helper scans column A for /AMS SHARED SUPPORT/i. Move phaseNames default to [] when allocations is empty. (2) Patch /app/frontend/src/utils/estimatorCalcs.js calculateWaveSummary to add `amsTotalCost = sum(hours_per_month * cost_rate) * contract_months` for AMS_Shared/AMS_Mix waves, include it in `costToCompany`, and expose both `amsTotalCost` (per wave) and `totalAmsCost` (in overall) so OverallSummary.js L138 subtitle renders. Then re-run live import of /tmp/xlsx_test/PRJ-0031_v2.xlsx and verify: (a) 4 wave tabs render including 'AMS ' (engagement_type=AMS_Shared, 1 bucket 150h × $35/$25, 12m, Monthly, Advance=ON); (b) [data-testid=total-ctc] equals implementation_CTC + sum(hours*cost_rate*months) across AMS waves; (c) subtitle '+ AMS cost ($X)' visible under Total CTC card; (d) Save → reload → all 4 waves and AMS fields persist; (e) 'Import as New Version' path also yields 4 waves on the new version. Login: admin@yash.com/password. Use Playwright with set_input_files on [data-testid=smart-import-input] then click [data-testid=confirm-import-btn] (Replace Current) or [data-testid=import-new-version-btn].
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE 1 (Import drops AMS_Shared sheet): /app/frontend/src/utils/excelImport.js parseEstimatorWorkbook L205 wraps logistics-parse + AMS-section-parse + parsedWaves.push inside `if (allocations.length > 0) { ... }`. The 'AMS ' sheet in /tmp/xlsx_test/PRJ-0031_v2.xlsx has 0 grid resource rows (engagement_type=AMS_Shared, only a 1-bucket AMS SHARED SUPPORT section), so the gate evaluates false and the entire AMS wave is dropped — both the section data AND the push to parsedWaves. The main agent's standalone /tmp/parse_full.cjs at L134 pushes unconditionally (no gate), masking this issue. REPRODUCTION: login admin@yash.com → /estimator?edit=78fc80fb-87aa-4f04-b30c-d34e9a399bb7 → set_input_files on [data-testid=smart-import-input]=/tmp/xlsx_test/PRJ-0031_v2.xlsx → wait for Smart Import Preview dialog → confirm shows '3 Waves Detected, 6 Total Resources' (NOT 4 waves) → click [data-testid=confirm-import-btn] → DOM shows 3 wave tabs only. MITIGATION: extend the gate to `allocations.length > 0 || sheetHasAmsSharedSupportMarker`. ROOT CAUSE 2 (Total CTC missing AMS cost): The PR commit edited /app/frontend/src/utils/calculations.js calculateWaveSummary at L115-129, but the live import in /app/frontend/src/pages/ProjectEstimator.js L16 reads `calculateOverallSummary` from /app/frontend/src/utils/estimatorCalcs.js — which still has costToCompany = base+overhead (no AMS) at L133. The two util files are near-duplicates that have drifted; calculations.js is effectively dead code. MITIGATION: port the AMS amsTotalCost addition into estimatorCalcs.js calculateWaveSummary, expose amsTotalCost on the return obj, aggregate totalAmsCost in calculateOverallSummary, and either delete calculations.js or re-route the import in ProjectEstimator.js.
